g.text: VDD1 decoupling not given by the DRAM data sheet

g.desc: VDD1 decoupling not given by the DRAM data sheet

g.text: 1. Function: 4 GB LPDDR4X, Micron MT53E1G32D2FW-046 IT:C (WT:C accepted), two 16 Gb dies, one

g.desc: 1. Function: 4 GB LPDDR4X, Micron MT53E1G32D2FW-046 IT:C (WT:C accepted), two 16 Gb dies, one

g.text: per channel, single rank (board ADR 0022 item 1).

g.desc: per channel, single rank (board ADR 0022 item 1).

g.text: 2. Open part, one land: the part choice stays open between Micron and the CXMT CXDB5CBAM-MA-B

g.desc: 2. Open part, one land: the part choice stays open between Micron and the CXMT CXDB5CBAM-MA-B

g.text: second source (ADR 0022, DRAM sourcing matrix); it plugs in only through this symbol and

g.desc: second source (ADR 0022, DRAM sourcing matrix); it plugs in only through this symbol and

g.text: the libs kicad/ land, sized for both bodies (10 x 15 mm envelope, 1.1 mm maximum height).

g.desc: the libs kicad/ land, sized for both bodies (10 x 15 mm envelope, 1.1 mm maximum height).

g.text: 3. Single rank: the RK3566 CS1, CKE1 and ODT1_CA outputs carry no-connect flags (blk.soc-ddr) and

g.desc: 3. Single rank: the RK3566 CS1, CKE1 and ODT1_CA outputs carry no-connect flags (blk.soc-ddr) and

g.text: ball A8 (ZQ1 on dual-rank parts) has no resistor. A dual-rank part needs a new decision and

g.desc: ball A8 (ZQ1 on dual-rank parts) has no resistor. A dual-rank part needs a new decision and

g.text: 4. Absent state: not applicable (never omitted; BRD-037). Supplies: VDD1 vcc1v8_ddr (always on),

g.desc: 4. Absent state: not applicable (never omitted; BRD-037). Supplies: VDD1 vcc1v8_ddr (always on),

g.text: VDD2 vcc_ddr (on in suspend), VDDQ vcc0v6_ddr from the TPS7A1006 (power tree §4.8).

g.desc: VDD2 vcc_ddr (on in suspend), VDDQ vcc0v6_ddr from the TPS7A1006 (power tree §4.8).

g.text: 5. Every ball goes to the same-named SoC ball, order not swapped (HDG 1.1 p. 22). ZQ0: 240 Ω

g.desc: 5. Every ball goes to the same-named SoC ball, order not swapped (HDG 1.1 p. 22). ZQ0: 240 Ω

g.text: 1 % to VDDQ (Micron z42n p. 33). Constraints: PCB-I-05.

g.desc: 1 % to VDDQ (Micron z42n p. 33). Constraints: PCB-I-05.

g.text: 6. Links: shunt in full, 0 Ω in production except H5 (BOM v1 line 137). FB3 senses vcc_ddr.

g.desc: 6. Links: shunt in full, 0 Ω in production except H5 (BOM v1 line 137). FB3 senses vcc_ddr.

g.text: 7. Open: VDD1 and VDDQ decoupling at the DRAM (data sheet silent, UNVERIFIED); the DNP

g.desc: 7. Open: VDD1 and VDDQ decoupling at the DRAM (data sheet silent, UNVERIFIED); the DNP

g.text: TPS7A2018 vcc1v8_ddr option of BOM v1 line 132 is not drawn yet.

g.desc: TPS7A2018 vcc1v8_ddr option of BOM v1 line 132 is not drawn yet.

g.text: 8. Unless noted: capacitors 0402 (100 nF 0201) X5R/X7R rated at least twice the rail; resistors 1 %.

g.desc: 8. Unless noted: capacitors 0402 (100 nF 0201) X5R/X7R rated at least twice the rail; resistors 1 %.
